0022600171.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-3, on a two-game losing streak, 1-2 on the road) visit the LA Clippers (1-5, on a five-game losing streak, 1-1 at home) for the 7th game of the Raptors' season, with no 2026-27 series meetings yet. The teams last met on March 25 in Los Angeles, when the Raptors lost 119-94, and the Raptors also lost 0-2 to the Clippers in the 2025-26 season. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), and Jakob Poeltl is day-to-day with shoulder inflammation and is a game-time decision, while the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (out, knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (out, Achilles surgery), Derrick Jones Jr. (out, knee soreness), Jordan Miller (out, shoulder surgery), Rui Hachimura (out, quadriceps bruise), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (out, foot surgery).
